relocation_line: I will relocate to Brisbane for this role and can start three weeks after an offer.
cover_letter_text:
Hi,

My name's Marc. I graduated in February 2026 with an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, and I'd like to start out as a civil design drafter. Your Brisbane civil team works on drainage, levels and grading with Civil 3D, which is the kind of documentation I trained for.

During the course I designed roads, earthworks and drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, and I studied the Austroads guides. Before that, on building sites in the Philippines, I was the one checking the drawings against the work. These days I work at a bp service station in Melbourne.

I'd move to Brisbane and can start three weeks after an offer. I have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa) and a Victorian driver's licence. Happy to chat any time.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate

questions.question: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
questions.answer: Subclass 485 Temporary Graduate visa with full working rights until December 2027.

questions.question: What's your expected annual base salary?
How many years' experience do you have as a civil drafter?
questions.answer: No paid drafting role. Prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D in the Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design (February 2024 to February 2026).

notes: Full-time civil design drafting in Civil 3D. Previous consultancy experience is listed as ideal, not a stated year minimum. Fit 75 (50 + 15 duty + 10 lane 1).
